name: GravityOps Forum – Lite
author: BrightLeaf Digital

sections.description:
GravityOps Forum turns Gravity Forms forms and entries into a working forum with categories, forums, topics, and replies, while keeping entries as the canonical data source.

Paid features include:
* Template Hijacking: Override default plugin templates within your own WordPress theme.
* Nested Forums: Create sub-categories and multi-level forum hierarchies.
* Additional Fields: Map additional Gravity Forms fields to display in topic and reply content.
* Gravity Forms Feeds: Use native feeds to automate topic/reply creation with full conditional logic support.
* Follow Content & Email Alerts: Enable users to follow topics, forums, and other users with automatic email notifications for new activity.
* Advanced Role Mapping: Map WordPress roles to specific forum access sets.
* Forum Boards: Group forums into logical boards.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0 | Aug 2, 2026

  • Added compatibility with Gravity Forms 2.9.31 and newer so mapped field values continue to display correctly in topics and replies.
  • Added a Docs tab so the full plugin documentation is available right inside your WordPress dashboard.
  • The plugin’s Gravity Forms settings tab now opens the GravityOps Forum dashboard, and the forum icon now shows on the settings tab and on the Gravity Flow forum step.
  • Refreshed the Help tab with documentation, community, and support links.
  • The Account, Pricing, and Affiliation tabs now only appear when they apply to your license.
  • Improved the GravityOps dashboard with per-plugin icons, correct changelog links, update checks that no longer hold up the page, and a fix for opening a plugin right after activating it.
  • Individual plugin pages are no longer listed in the WordPress admin sidebar; open them from the GravityOps dashboard instead.
  • Updated the core GravityOps library for more reliable support access, interface fixes that are no longer served from a stale cache, and other small fixes.

1.0.1 | Jun 15, 2026

  • Improved the upgrade experience when moving from the free version to premium.
  • Added safeguards to help prevent activation issues when both versions are present during an upgrade.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
